description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractController' within the OrangeHRM system, providing base functionality for controllers, including response handling, response creation, and validation. It uses traits for shared behavior and manages HTTP response objects.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: Provides a base class for controllers handling HTTP responses, with methods to get and set responses, handle bad requests, and initialize new response objects.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the current response object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object; throws an exception if the provided argument isn't a valid Response or RedirectResponse.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Sets the response status code to HTTP 400 Bad Request and returns the response.
